proposal.payload_json: {"interpretations":[{"basis":"The policy could be read as a complete specification (closed-world reading): 'Whenever an account is frozen, do not allow an outgoing transfer' defines the ONLY condition under which blocking is required. Under this reading, blocking when the account is NOT frozen is also a violation, because the policy exhaustively specifies when transfers must be blocked.
